diagnosis.description: Two to four sentences: what users experience, what the evidence shows, since when.

root_cause.description: The specific code path, switch or dependency responsible, with file:line where known.

proposed_action.description: One of the actions in autonomy-policy.yaml.

fix_summary.description: For fix_in_worktree: what was changed in the worktree and why. Empty otherwise.

confidence.description: How sure the diagnosis is, 0 to 1.

needs_human.description: True when a person must look before or after the action.

verification.description: What observation would show the incident is over (metric, log line, endpoint).
